item.title: Deal with Epstein lawyer and accountant could block victims’ other claims, experts warn
item.description:
Concern that settlement to resolve suit against pair may stymie legal claims that involve child sexual abuse material

As the clock ticks toward final settlement for a sex-trafficking-related lawsuit against Jeffrey Epstein’s accountant and attorney, some experts are expressing concern that the agreement might stymie survivors’ search for justice in other litigation involving child sexual abuse images.

The suit involves Darren Indyke and Richard D Kahn, who for decades worked as Epstein’s personal lawyer and accountant respectively. Both men also serve as executors of Epstein’s estate. Indyke and Kahn have insisted they knew nothing about Epstein’s crimes and have rejected allegations of wrongdoing.

item.title: US oligarchs enriched by ‘transactional’ Trump face fierce scrutiny in new Congress
item.description:
Democrats pledge aggressive investigations into Trump-allied billionaires and how president’s policies have boosted their bottom lines

For an elite circle of Donald Trump billionaire allies who lavished tens of millions of dollars on his campaign, vanity projects and crypto ventures, his second administration has boosted their bottom lines through lax oversight, tax breaks, federal contracts and other perks.

But with Democrats winning control of Congress in the midterms, House and Senate investigations are being planned for 2027 into several Maga oligarchs in hi-tech and crypto industries, examining how their firms and the president benefited from his “transactional” governing style, according to Democratic lawmakers and scholars.

item.title: Naughty lesbians ruined Donald Trump Jr’s Thanksgiving | Arwa Mahdawi
item.description:
It seems Trump Jr was innocently scrolling social media when he saw that Netflix had posted a video of two women kissing, spoiling his holiday

Picture the scene: Thanksgiving in Donald Trump Jr’s household. The table is set, the turkey is carved, and the president’s oldest son, incandescent with rage, is choking on his brussels sprouts.

What happened to the poor 48-year-old boy, one might ask? Did daddy Trump tell him, once again, that his beard was hideous? Did his former fiance, Kimberly Guilfoyle, ask him to pay off her American Express bill? Did brother Barron force him to try one of his energy drinks?

Arwa Mahdawi is a Guardian columnist and the author of Strong Female Lead

Dismantling patriarchy: An evening of conversation, art and resistance. On Monday 1 March 2027, join Arwa Mahdawi and One Billion Rising as we bring together activists and artists to question patriarchy and power, and celebrate resistance.
